info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Insurance Claims Claims Documents-v3-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Document Retrieval API allows users to access and list documents related to insurance claims efficiently. This endpoint provides essential information regarding the claims' documentation, enabling stakeholders, such as insurance adjusters and claims processors, to retrieve necessary files for review and analysis. It ensures that users have quick access to the documentation required to facilitate decision-making processes and enhance operational workflows. Ideal for integrating with claims management systems, this API simplifies data retrieval tasks associated with insurance claims.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of documents related to claims.
get.description: This endpoint allows the user to retrieve documents associated with various claims. It serves as a valuable tool for accessing essential documentation to assist in the claims process.
